name: cmw
description: Connects this Claude Code session to your team's mesh: teammates' agents can ask, assign, review and plan with you, and their messages arrive in your session.

agent_id.title: Agent id
agent_id.description: Your agent's id, e.g. alice-agent. Leave empty to join with an invite (/cmw:join).

nats_url.title: Hub URL
nats_url.description: NATS URL of your team's hub, e.g. nats://100.64.0.10:4222 (comma-separate several). Leave empty to join with an invite.

nkey_seed.title: Credentials
nkey_seed.description: Your nkey seed (SU…) or the path to your .nk file from `cmw keys add`. Leave empty for a dev hub without auth.

prefix.title: Subject prefix
prefix.description: mesh.prefix from the hub's mesh.yaml (empty means mesh). Leave empty if you join with an invite: ~/.cosmicwave/agent.json sets it and wins over this option.
